sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A precision fight in 3 phases (100-75%, 75-40%, 40-0%) plus two intermissions, built around not letting "Sparks" reach her. Tight 10-minute enrage — low-DPS squads feel it hard in the final 10%.

sections.heading: Fluxlance & conduits
bullets: <mark>Fluxlance</mark> targets the furthest player(s) — after a 5s cast it fires a beam that applies Galvanic Sensitivity (massively boosts Spark damage to whoever's hit) and charges any conduit in its path. Phase 1 is a single beam; phase 2 upgrades to <mark>Fluxlance Fusillade</mark> (sequential beams at the 5 furthest players), phase 3 to <mark>Fluxlance Salvo</mark> (the same, but simultaneous).
Red Arrow (all phases) instantly kills anyone in its path — stand behind an uncharged conduit to block it.
Conduits charge up to 3 times and release sparks during Seismic Crash — a Spark reaching Decima gives her a Charge stack, and 10 stacks is a squad wipe.

sections.heading: Sparks
bullets: <mark>Sparking Aura</mark> is what releases the sparks from charged conduits, drifting toward Decima. Sparks freeze once enough players are standing in them (more players = faster dissipation). In phase 1, anyone not kiting can soak a spark; in phases 2-3, only the boss group should soak — Galvanic Sensitivity makes it lethal for anyone else.

sections.heading: Seismic Crash, Swirling Winds, and Green Arrow
bullets: <mark>Seismic Crash</mark>: an instant-kill jump-crash near her, followed by a knockback and then a Spark release — Stability or CC-immunity gets you through it safely.

<mark>Swirling Winds</mark> (phases 2-3): forcibly rotates players around her, clockwise or counter-clockwise depending on the cast — fully countered by Stability. Phase 2 only affects the outer ring; phase 3 hits the whole platform.
Green Arrow (phase 3 only): 5 players must stand in it at detonation or the whole squad gets Exposed — missing players makes the targeted conduit overcharge instead.

sections.heading: Intermissions (75% / 40%)
bullets: Decima channels with a defiance bar while everyone loses Galvanic Sensitivity, so the whole squad can soak Sparks freely — break the bar for a 10-second stun, but any Spark that reaches her during this fully regenerates it.

Each intermission ends with <mark>Flux Nova</mark> — Decima gathers arcane flux into an unstable orb and detonates it after several seconds, hitting every conduit at once. Any conduit at max charge when this goes off gives the squad an Exposed stack and Decima 5 stacks of Harmony and Discord each (which fuel her <mark>Chorus of Thunder</mark> attack), so clear conduits down before the detonation.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 hard enrage — tighter than most other raid bosses, so don't expect to coast through phase 3.

cmSections.heading: What's different in Challenge Mote ("Godsquall Decima")
bullets: Decima is linked to a minion — if her health drops too low relative to it, the minion shields her and exposes itself instead. You may need to redirect damage onto the minion rather than just burning Decima directly.
An extra <mark>Fluxlance Salvo</mark> shows up at 40% health, firing beams simultaneously rather than in sequence — a step up in difficulty from Normal's phase progression.
New repositioning attacks have her leap to new spots before crashing down, changing up the predictable positioning you'd rely on in Normal.
Treat Charge management as a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have — several CM achievements exist specifically around never letting her gain a single Charge stack.
